set -eu
for i in $(seq 1 60); do
  device=$(lsblk -dpno NAME,SERIAL | awk '$2=="vol0a68d42cd153ab959" {print $1}')
  [ -n "$device" ] && break
  sleep 2
done
test -n "${device:-}"
if ! sudo blkid "$device" >/dev/null 2>&1; then sudo mkfs.ext4 -F "$device"; fi
uuid=$(sudo blkid -s UUID -o value "$device")
sudo mkdir -p /var/lib/easydep-postgres
grep -q "$uuid" /etc/fstab || echo "UUID=$uuid /var/lib/easydep-postgres ext4 defaults,nofail 0 2" | sudo tee -a /etc/fstab >/dev/null
sudo mount -a
sudo chown 999:999 /var/lib/easydep-postgres
sudo docker rm -f easydep-state >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
sudo docker run -d --name easydep-state --restart unless-stopped   -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD='<redacted-password>' -p 5432:5432   -v /var/lib/easydep-postgres:/var/lib/postgresql/data:Z postgres:17-bookworm
for i in $(seq 1 90); do
  sudo docker exec easydep-state pg_isready -U postgres && exit 0
  sleep 2
done
exit 1
